findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "find_cpv_codes" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_public_tenders · Private data: search_public_tenders, get_public_tender, find_cpv_codes · Public sink: search_public_tenders · Destructive: search_public_tenders, find_cpv_codes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_public_tenders · Private data: search_public_tenders, get_public_tender, find_cpv_codes · Public sink: search_public_tenders · Destructive: search_public_tenders, find_cpv_codes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
